verdict.rationale: The docs include a server-side support page and a typedoc entry for BABYLON.NullEngine, which points to a headless engine mode that can run outside a browser. That is the basis for running game code in CI against the real engine, but the pack gives only the page URLs, not their content, and nothing describes a testing or CI workflow. missing for 10: documented content describing NullEngine/server-side behavior, guidance on unit/integration testing in CI, hands-on or community corroboration of headless test runs, any mention of rendering or WebGL-dependent code under test.
